title: Find the first occurrence of a word
description: Write a function `first_occurrence(text, word)` that returns the index of the first occurrence of `word` in `text`.
examples:
first_occurrence(
    'You cannot end a sentence with because because because is a conjunction',
    'because',
)
-> 31
hints: Method to consider: str.find() or str.index()
A 'word' is just a longer substring - .find() and .index() work exactly the same way whether you're searching for one character or several.
Call .index(word) on text and return the result.
expected_behavior: Returns the index where word first appears in text.

hidden_tests.call: first_occurrence('You cannot end a sentence with because because because is a conjunction', 'because')

explanation: Searching for a multi-character word works identically to searching for a single character - the method doesn't care about the length of what it's looking for.
